Resolve

You'll see a pixelated face and a lineup of look-alikes. Pick the match. A new face appears each round, the image gets a little clearer as you go, and the pixel shape itself changes partway through — there's no way to prepare, just go with your first instinct.

  • 01The session runs in three blocks (one per grid type), each with a short practice round first.
  • 02No right/wrong feedback is shown — this keeps later rounds unbiased.
  • 03Takes about 8–10 minutes. Responses are logged anonymously for this research project.
